proof.frequency: k=ceil(epsilon^-1/2), 0<epsilon<1 imply 1<=epsilon*k^2<(1+sqrt(epsilon))^2<4. The original k is enclosed separately and remains in every physical derivative scale.
proof.cutoff: At this proved point every mesh offset has absolute value<9/16. The original bump is at least sigma(3/8)>exp(-5)/2>1/512. The complete three-translate square-root denominator is below2, so each factor>2^-10. The band factor is1. proof.point: The original inverse-map proof places T in(15/16,17/16), and R=sqrt(T)*sqrt(2X). No old point-specific field or carrier value is transplanted.
proof.scaleInterpretation: Every one of the270 positive normalizers is rebuilt by an exact source recipe and compared literally to its original root. Directed arithmetic evaluates an algebraically identical common-factor monomial before interval enclosure. A0=tau^(1/2)*g^(1/4)*Ls^(1/4)/r0 and massScale=r0^2*g^(-1/2)*Ls^(-1/2). For physical rows Bs=sqrt(2Fgamma)*u^(-3/2)/[(k sqrt epsilon)*(1+u^-2)^(3/4)], Ac=gamma*u*sqrt(1+u^-2), gabs=2F(1+gamma^2). The n copies of k cancel the n copies of k in Bs. The remaining Q exponent is -(1+n_spatial+2n_time)/2-h*(1+n+2n_time)/2. All powers of each repeated positive factor are combined first. The factors1+u^-2 and1+gamma^2 lie in[1,2], giving the explicit positive scalar bracket in the generic kernel; no rounding value is changed.
proof.precision: The finite positive endpoints contain only numerical rational constants and exp/neg. Their explicitly named iterated-log coordinate widths meet the request. No original-value relative tolerance is asserted. T and eta_beta are separately labeled coarse positive rational bounds; the dependent astronomical physical scales still have their requested log-coordinate widths checked.
proof.sourceBounds: The eight original FTC constants are upper-bounded by a separately authenticated n1,m5 construction. Original first historical and small-band terms are kept.
